source.title: The Education (Curriculum Minimum Content) Order (Northern Ireland) 2007, Schedule 2
source.credit: Northern Ireland Curriculum statutory requirements, from The Education (Curriculum Minimum Content) Order (Northern Ireland) 2007: © Crown copyright. Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.text: Explore self employment and identify relevant sources of support

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.text: Examine the impact of globalisation on employment

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.text: Investigate the recruitment and selection process, taking into account the rights and responsibilities of employees and employers

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.text: Consider how employees and employers might maintain an effective working environment

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.text: Investigate the increasing social responsibility of business in the community

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.text: Develop a personal career plan based on relevant information and guidance.

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.text: Develop an understanding of how to maximise and sustain their own health and well-being

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.text: Reflect on, and respond to, their developing concept of self, including managing emotions and reactions to on-going life experiences

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.text: Recognise, assess and manage risk in a range of real-life contexts

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.text: Develop their understanding of relationships and sexuality and the responsibilities of healthy relationships

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.text: Develop an understanding of the roles and responsibilities of parenting

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.text: Develop further their competence as discerning consumers in preparation for independent living.

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.text: Receive age-appropriate, comprehensive and scientifically accurate education on sexual and reproductive health and rights covering prevention of early pregnancy and access to abortion.

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.text: Respond to the specific challenges and opportunities which diversity and inclusion present in Northern Ireland and the wider world

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.text: Identify and exercise their rights and social responsibilities in relation to local, national and global issues

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.text: Develop their understanding of the role of society and government in safeguarding individual and collective rights in order to promote equality and to ensure that everyone is treated fairly

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.text: Develop their understanding of how to participate in a range of democratic processes

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.text: Develop awareness of key democratic institutions and their role in promoting inclusion, justice and democracy

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.text: Develop awareness of the role of non-governmental organisations.

statements.subject: Physical Education
statements.text: Plan and participate in a regular, frequent and balanced programme of physical activity that: (a) develops their interests and talents (b) extends their knowledge, understanding and skills (c) contributes to, and helps sustain, a healthy and active lifestyle

statements.subject: Physical Education
statements.text: Evaluate their own performances and that of others

statements.subject: Physical Education
statements.text: Recognise and manage risk and apply safe principles and procedures before, during and after physical activity

statements.subject: Physical Education
statements.text: Experience and understand different roles within a range of physical activities

statements.subject: Physical Education
statements.text: Know how to access sporting and recreational opportunities in the local and wider community.
